name: pi coding agent
description: Installs the pi coding agent with a private Node runtime that is kept off PATH, so it cannot shadow the workspace toolchain, plus ripgrep and fd on PATH so pi never downloads them at runtime.

version.description: npm version of @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent. dev-up pins this to the host's pi version so the image hash changes exactly when you upgrade.

nodeVersion.description: Private Node runtime installed under /opt/pi/node. Never added to PATH.

ripgrepVersion.description: ripgrep installed to /usr/local/bin/rg. pi resolves rg from its tools dir, then PATH, and downloads it from GitHub if neither has it; baking it in avoids that at runtime.

fdVersion.description: fd installed to /usr/local/bin/fd. Same rationale as ripgrep: pi otherwise downloads it from GitHub on first use.
